title: Source ticker and current ticker are distinct bindings, never interchangeable

sourceObjects.ref: explicit structured input: ticker binding configuration v1

concepts.name: sourceTicker
concepts.identityMeaning: binds to the source-of-truth registry ticker T at the moment the decision was read
concepts.failureBehavior: a sourceTicker that equals the current ticker by coincidence is still the source ticker

concepts.name: currentTicker
concepts.identityMeaning: binds to the currently visible registry ticker at the time of evaluation
concepts.failureBehavior: currentTicker is read live; it never replaces sourceTicker in binding checks

distinctConcepts.mustNotConflate: source/current ticker binding: equality of values does not make the bindings interchangeable; sourceTicker is frozen at decision time, currentTicker is live

factsEstablished.fact: sourceTicker is captured at decision-read time; currentTicker is read at evaluation time
